title: What Lived Experience Brings Beyond the Checklist
description: Understand why lived experience with disability and assistive technologies is essential for effective accessibility QA — moving beyond automated checks to meaningful usability.

title: Barriers, Not Inconveniences
description: The conceptual groundwork every audit finding rests on: what separates a barrier from an inconvenience, why the medical and social models of disability lead to different defect write-ups for the same bug, and the range of access needs an audit has to cover beyond blindness.

title: Why Automation Isn't the Audit
description: What automated scanners reliably catch, what they structurally can't, and how to sequence a real audit so the scan is a triage step rather than the finish line.
